stories.title: Did the Rams, Cowboys and Pats just save their seasons? Barnwell on their fourth-quarter comebacks
stories.summary: The Rams, Cowboys and Pats were all looking at 1-3 ... then everything changed. How did a trio of stunning rallies play out -- and are these teams all back on track at 2-2?

stories.title: Let's overreact to Week 4: Trouble looming in Philly? Chiefs the league's best?
stories.summary: We look at five potential takeaways and judge them as legitimate stances or irrational exaggerations.

stories.title: NFL looking into official apparently cursing at Cards TE McBride
stories.summary: The NFL says it is reviewing an official's apparent use of profanity directed at Cardinals tight end Trey McBride in Sunday's game against the Giants.

stories.title: Sources: Thornton dislocates ankle in win, Chiefs 'in contact' with Tyreek Hill
stories.summary: Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver Tyquan Thornton, injured in Sunday's 30-27 victory over the Las Vegas Raiders, suffered a dislocated ankle that was put back into place by doctors, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Bills DB dismisses Chism, hero in Pats' win, as 'practice squad player'
stories.summary: C.J. Gardner-Johnson dismissed Efton Chism III as a "practice squad player" and said the Patriots WR's one-handed TD catch "probably" will never happen again.
